announcements.title: Family Sunday
announcements.details: The first Sunday of Advent. Our students lead worship, and all ages stay together for the whole service. We read John 11, where Jesus raises Lazarus.

announcements.title: Deck the Halls
announcements.details: Stay after the service and help us decorate the church for Christmas. All ages are welcome.

announcements.title: Food Pantry
announcements.details: The Andrew County Food Pantry November collection is baking supplies: vanilla, baking powder, baking soda, chocolate chips and the like. Next Sunday is the last Sunday to bring them.

announcements.title: Ice Skating Party
announcements.details: Mark your calendar for our annual church ice skating party. All ages are welcome, and pizza is provided. More details will come this winter.
